general_rules: Costs: Tarot $3, Planet $3, Spectral $4 (sell = max(1, floor(cost/2)) -> $1, $1, $2).
'select' gives how many highlighted hand cards the card accepts (min..max). Cards that 'create' something need a free consumable/joker slot; created count is limited by free slots.
No duplicates of a consumable already held / in the shop / in the open pack unless Showman is owned. Fallbacks when a pool is exhausted: Tarot -> Strength, Planet -> Pluto, Spectral -> Incantation.
Tarot/Planet/Spectral cards can be used from the consumable area at any time (Tarots that target cards need cards in hand, e.g. during a round or inside an Arcana/Spectral pack).
The Soul and Black Hole never appear in the shop or from Sixth Sense/Seance; only from packs (0.3% per card slot).
Observatory voucher: every Planet card held in the consumable area gives x1.5 Mult when its hand is played (applied after all jokers).

tarots.name: The Fool
tarots.effect: Creates a copy of the last Tarot or Planet card used this run (The Fool itself is excluded; Spectral cards never count). Needs a free consumable slot; the copy has no edition.

tarots.name: The Magician
tarots.effect: Turns up to 2 selected cards into Lucky Cards.

tarots.name: The High Priestess
tarots.effect: Creates up to 2 random Planet cards (limited by free consumable slots).

tarots.name: The Empress
tarots.effect: Turns up to 2 selected cards into Mult Cards.

tarots.name: The Emperor
tarots.effect: Creates up to 2 random Tarot cards (limited by free consumable slots).

tarots.name: The Hierophant
tarots.effect: Turns up to 2 selected cards into Bonus Cards. (Internal key is misspelled 'heirophant' in the game.)

tarots.name: The Lovers
tarots.effect: Turns 1 selected card into a Wild Card.

tarots.name: The Chariot
tarots.effect: Turns 1 selected card into a Steel Card.

tarots.name: Justice
tarots.effect: Turns 1 selected card into a Glass Card.

tarots.name: The Hermit
tarots.effect: Gain money equal to your current money, capped at +$20. Gives nothing while in debt.

tarots.name: The Wheel of Fortune
tarots.effect: 1 in 4 chance to give a random edition-less joker Foil (50%), Holographic (35%) or Polychrome (15%); otherwise 'Nope!'. Unusable if every joker already has an edition.

tarots.name: Strength
tarots.effect: Raises the rank of up to 2 selected cards by 1 (K -> A, A wraps to 2).

tarots.name: The Hanged Man
tarots.effect: Destroys up to 2 selected cards.

tarots.name: Death
tarots.effect: Select exactly 2 cards: the LEFT card becomes an exact copy of the RIGHT card (rank, suit, enhancement, edition, seal, Hiker chips).

tarots.name: Temperance
tarots.effect: Gain the combined current sell value of all your jokers, capped at $50 (debuffed jokers count; $0 with no jokers).

tarots.name: The Devil
tarots.effect: Turns 1 selected card into a Gold Card.

tarots.name: The Tower
tarots.effect: Turns 1 selected card into a Stone Card.

tarots.name: The Star
tarots.effect: Changes up to 3 selected cards to Diamonds.

tarots.name: The Moon
tarots.effect: Changes up to 3 selected cards to Clubs.

tarots.name: The Sun
tarots.effect: Changes up to 3 selected cards to Hearts.

tarots.name: Judgement
tarots.effect: Creates a random joker (70% Common / 25% Uncommon / 5% Rare, never Legendary, may roll an edition, never gets stickers). Needs a free joker slot.

tarots.name: The World
tarots.effect: Changes up to 3 selected cards to Spades.

planets.name: Pluto
planets.effect: Levels up High Card by 1 (+10 chips, +1 mult).

planets.name: Mercury
planets.effect: Levels up Pair by 1 (+15 chips, +1 mult).

planets.name: Uranus
planets.effect: Levels up Two Pair by 1 (+20 chips, +1 mult).

planets.name: Venus
planets.effect: Levels up Three of a Kind by 1 (+20 chips, +2 mult).

planets.name: Saturn
planets.effect: Levels up Straight by 1 (+30 chips, +3 mult).

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.effect: Levels up Flush by 1 (+15 chips, +2 mult).

planets.name: Earth
planets.effect: Levels up Full House by 1 (+25 chips, +2 mult).

planets.name: Mars
planets.effect: Levels up Four of a Kind by 1 (+30 chips, +3 mult).

planets.name: Neptune
planets.effect: Levels up Straight Flush by 1 (+40 chips, +4 mult).

planets.name: Planet X
planets.effect: Levels up Five of a Kind by 1 (+35 chips, +3 mult).
planets.spawn_condition: Only appears after Five of a Kind has been played this run.

planets.name: Ceres
planets.effect: Levels up Flush House by 1 (+40 chips, +4 mult).
planets.spawn_condition: Only appears after Flush House has been played this run.

planets.name: Eris
planets.effect: Levels up Flush Five by 1 (+50 chips, +3 mult).
planets.spawn_condition: Only appears after Flush Five has been played this run.

spectrals.name: Familiar
spectrals.effect: Destroy 1 random card in hand, then add 3 random Enhanced face cards (J/Q/K, never Stone) to hand.

spectrals.name: Grim
spectrals.effect: Destroy 1 random card in hand, then add 2 random Enhanced Aces (never Stone) to hand.

spectrals.name: Incantation
spectrals.effect: Destroy 1 random card in hand, then add 4 random Enhanced number cards (2-10, never Stone) to hand.

spectrals.name: Talisman
spectrals.effect: Add a Gold Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Aura
spectrals.effect: Give 1 selected edition-less card in hand Foil (50%), Holographic (35%) or Polychrome (15%).

spectrals.name: Wraith
spectrals.effect: Create a random Rare joker (needs a free joker slot) and set money to $0 (also wipes debt).

spectrals.name: Sigil
spectrals.effect: Convert every card in hand to one random suit (same suit for all).

spectrals.name: Ouija
spectrals.effect: Convert every card in hand to one random rank (same rank for all); permanently -1 hand size.

spectrals.name: Ectoplasm
spectrals.effect: Give a random edition-less joker the Negative edition; permanently lose hand size. In-game text says -1, but the loss grows with each use in a run (1st use -1, 2nd -2, 3rd -3 ...).
spectrals.hand_size: -(number of times Ectoplasm used this run, including this one)

spectrals.name: Immolate
spectrals.effect: Destroy 5 random cards in hand and gain $20.

spectrals.name: Ankh
spectrals.effect: Copy a random joker (keeps edition except Negative, keeps stickers and scaling) and destroy all other non-Eternal jokers. Needs a free joker slot.

spectrals.name: Deja Vu
spectrals.effect: Add a Red Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Hex
spectrals.effect: Give a random edition-less joker Polychrome and destroy all other non-Eternal jokers.

spectrals.name: Trance
spectrals.effect: Add a Blue Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Medium
spectrals.effect: Add a Purple Seal to 1 selected card.

spectrals.name: Cryptid
spectrals.effect: Create 2 exact copies of 1 selected card in hand (all modifiers copied).

spectrals.name: The Soul
spectrals.effect: Create a random Legendary joker (needs a free joker slot). Never sold in the shop; each card in an Arcana or Spectral pack has a 0.3% chance to be The Soul.

spectrals.name: Black Hole
spectrals.effect: Level up every poker hand (including unplayed secret hands) by 1. Never sold in the shop; each card in a Celestial or Spectral pack (and Omen-Globe spectral slots of Arcana packs) has a 0.3% chance to be Black Hole.
